notes: Running words about 1,455 (target 1,330, window 1,197–1,463): five planning branches plus the departure and the road need the room; trimmed twice from a 1,890-word draft. 'braf' is not mutated after yn (Mae hi'n braf); the three lint-yn warnings on it are expected.

Narration is now in the past (Rhan 3 default): preterite for events, imperfect for background; group actions take noun subjects with a 3sg verb (Gadawodd y gert y llys, dilynodd y ceffylau'r ffordd). No pronoun-subject plural preterites before Pennod 23.

Target: os appears in ten-plus conditions, most with bydd (Os bydd hi'n bwrw eira / glaw, Os bydd rhew / niwl / lladron, Os bydd dynion yn gweld draig, Os byddwch chi'n aros), and with the present in the question form (Os wyt ti'n sâl, Os dw i'n aros yma, Os wyt ti'n aros yma). Contrasts: Cynyr's 'Pan fydd yr haul yn dod' against Mali's 'Os bydd yr haul yn dod' (pan ✓ ↔ os ?), and present against future conditions.

Weather idioms (Mae hi'n oer / wyntog / braf, bwrw eira / glaw, niwl, rhew) carry the departure. Deliberate error: Dafi's 'os bydd e'n bwrw eira' (s-label err) is corrected by Mali in the next line ('Hi: mae hi'n bwrw eira'), contrasting the weather idiom with hi.

cert is treated as feminine, as the plan lists it (y gert, i'r gert; plural ceirt) — flagged [?] for the fluent reviewer. sach is feminine (sach fawr, sach goch); 'sach fara' is written with soft mutation of the dependent noun after a feminine noun (cf. basged fara) — also flagged.

Continuity: secret sec-dafi resolved for Cynyr and Elen. Elen knew all along ('Ro'n i'n gwybod … Dw i'n gweld pob peth yn y llys'); Cynyr learns on the road and laughs ('Pawb yn y llys, a dim Cynyr!'). Mali, who cannot lie, names everyone who knew. Modlen, Pero and the servants stay at the llys; Modlen plans to come to Caerllion for the Calan feast with carts of food if the weather is fine (sets up Pennod 29, 'Modlen, arrived with the carts'). Myrddin's empty hat: 'Does dim byd yn yr het, Modlen' (callback to 6, this time true).

Travelling party: Cynyr (old white horse), Cai (young horse, sword, shield, red cloak), Elen (on a horse), Arth, Mali and Myrddin in the cart with the sacks; Dafi in the white bread sack; Myrddin's umbrella. Arth still has the cold from 19–20 and takes Myrddin's medicine; he wears Cai's old coat (too long) and gloves.
Checker artefact: the phrase lexeme cy-ph-or-gloch makes every 'o'r' count as a Pennod 18 word (known checker bug); prose was not changed for it.

primary_new_grammar.label: os + present / future for real conditions (Os bydd hi'n bwrw eira, byddwn ni'n …; Os wyt ti'n sâl, byddi di'n …), contrasted with pan + SM (pan fydd); weather idioms with hi (Mae hi'n bwrw glaw / eira, Mae hi'n braf / wyntog / oer)

cover.alt: In the first falling snow the family sets out down the valley past Myrddin's tower: Arth, in a coat far too big for him, Mali and Myrddin ride in a cart loaded with sacks, with Cynyr and Cai on horseback ahead and Elen riding beside them.
cover.art_brief: Winter morning on the road down Cwm Helyg, just past the stone bridge, with Myrddin's crooked grey stone tower small among the trees behind (valley palette: greens and slate under a grey sky; mist lying on the mountains). Snow has just begun to fall, the first flakes settling on the road and on Myrddin's hat. A plain wooden two-wheeled cart piled with tied cloth sacks, one white sack on top, pulled by one horse, rolls slowly along the road. In the cart: Arth (11, untidy brown hair with cowlick, wearing Cai's old brown coat, far too big, reaching his ankles, over the green tunic, and big gloves), Mali (12, long dark braid, dark-blue dress under a hooded oatmeal-grey winter cloak, satchel), and Myrddin (very old, white beard, round spectacles, tall black brimmed hat with snow on it, holding his long black umbrella). Ahead, Cynyr (huge golden-blond beard, brown cloak) on his old white horse and Cai (15, red-blond, red cloak, sword and round red shield) on his young chestnut horse; Elen (white veil, green dress, long dark-green hooded cloak, keys) rides beside the cart. No text.

segments.text: Roedd hi'n fore oer yn Llys Cynyr, ac roedd pawb yn paratoi: yfory, roedd y teulu'n mynd ar y daith hir i Gaerllion.
Am saith o'r gloch, daeth Dafi o het Myrddin gyda'r oriawr: "Saith o'r gloch!"
Agorodd Cynyr ddrws y neuadd, ac edrychodd e ar yr awyr lwyd.
"Sut mae'r tywydd, Dad?" meddai Mali.
segments.speaker: char-mali

segments.text: "Mae hi'n oer, ac mae hi'n wyntog," meddai Cynyr.
segments.speaker: char-cynyr

segments.text: "Ddoe roedd hi'n braf, ond heddiw mae'r gwynt yn gryf."
"Os bydd hi'n bwrw eira yfory, fyddwn ni'n mynd?" meddai Mali.
segments.speaker: char-mali

segments.text: "Byddwn!" meddai Cynyr.
segments.speaker: char-cynyr

segments.text: "Os bydd hi'n bwrw eira, byddwn ni'n mynd yn araf, ac os bydd hi'n bwrw glaw, byddwn ni'n wlyb."
Tisiodd Arth yn uchel.
"Mae annwyd a pheswch arnat ti, Arth," meddai Elen.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Os wyt ti'n sâl, byddi di'n aros yma gyda Modlen."
"Dw i ddim yn sâl, Mam!" meddai Arth.
segments.speaker: char-arth

segments.text: "Dim ond annwyd bach yw e."
"Os dw i'n aros yma, bydda i'n drist iawn!"
"Os bydd niwl ar y mynyddoedd, fyddwn ni ddim yn gweld y ffordd," meddai Myrddin wrth y tân.
segments.speaker: char-myrddin

inference_aids.alt: Elen in the llys hall packing clothes into three big sacks on a bench, handing Arth a long coat that reaches his feet; Cai holds up only his sword and red cloak; Mali packs her diary, quill and ink into a small sack.
inference_aids.art_brief: Inside the llys hall by day (match place-neuadd.png; llys palette, firelight from the central hearth). Three big cloth sacks on a long bench, piles of clothes on the table and chairs: wool shirts, trousers, socks, gloves, boots and heavy coats, clearly drawn so each kind of garment can be told apart. Elen (white veil, green dress, keys at her belt) holds Cai's old brown coat up against Arth (11, untidy brown hair with cowlick, moss-green tunic): it reaches his feet; he already wears big gloves. Cai (15, red-blond, rust-red tunic) proudly holds up his sword, round red shield and red cloak, nothing else. Mali (12, long dark braid, dark-blue dress) puts a small book, a white quill and an ink pot into a small sack. Myrddin (white beard, round spectacles, tall black hat) stands by the hearth spreading his hands to show the long deep-blue robe he is wearing. No text.

segments.text: "Dillad i'r daith," meddai Elen.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Os bydd hi'n oer, bydd angen dillad cynnes arnoch chi."
"Dau grys, dau drowsus, pedair hosan a blanced i bob plentyn: dyma nhw."
"Pedair hosan?" meddai Cai.
segments.speaker: char-cai

segments.text: "Ond mae dwy droed gyda fi, Mam, dim pedair!"
"Os bydd eira yn dy esgidiau di, bydd dy sanau di'n wlyb," meddai Elen.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Wedyn bydd angen sanau sych arnat ti."
Ond doedd Cai ddim eisiau dillad.
Paciodd e ei gleddyf, ei darian a'i glogyn coch: dim crys, dim trowsus, dim sanau.
"Does dim angen dillad ar farchog!" meddai Cai.
segments.speaker: char-cai

segments.text: "Os bydd hi'n bwrw glaw, bydd dy glogyn di'n wlyb, Cai," meddai Elen, a rhoddodd hi hen got Cynyr yn sach Cai.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Ac Arth: oes menig gyda ti?"
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Nac oes, Mam," meddai Arth.
segments.speaker: char-arth

segments.text: Rhoddodd Elen hen fenig Cai i Arth, a hen got Cai hefyd.
Roedd y got yn fawr: roedd hi'n cyrraedd traed Arth!
"Gwisga dy got, Arth," meddai Elen.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Os wyt ti'n gynnes, byddi di'n gwella."
Paciodd Mali ei dyddiadur hi, ei phluen hi a'r inc mewn sach fach.
"Ble mae eich dillad chi, Myrddin?" meddai Elen.
segments.speaker: char-elen

segments.text: "Dych chi ddim wedi pacio dim byd!"
"Dyma nhw," meddai Myrddin, ac edrychodd e ar ei glogyn hir, glas.
segments.speaker: char-myrddin

segments.text: "Dw i'n gwisgo fy nillad i."
Yn y gegin, roedd Modlen yn pobi drwy'r dydd.
Roedd hi'n rhoi bara, caws, cig ac afalau mewn sachau mawr, ac roedd y gweision yn cario'r sachau i'r gert yn y buarth.

inference_aids.label: cert

segments.speaker: char-cynyr

segments.speaker: char-modlen

segments.text: "Does dim gormod o fwyd ar daith!"

segments.text: "Dw i ddim yn ofni lleidr!"

segments.speaker: char-modlen

segments.text: "Dyma ddigon o fara i bawb, a dyma ddigon o gaws, ac mae digon o gig yn y sach goch."

"A Dafi?" meddai Arth.
segments.speaker: char-arth

segments.text: "Os bydd e'n dod gyda ni, bydd e'n cynnau tân i ni bob nos."

segments.speaker: char-modlen

segments.text: "Os bydd dynion yn gweld draig ar y ffordd, byddan nhw'n ofni, a bydd y milwyr yn dod gyda'u cleddyfau. Mae draig yn beryglus!"

segments.speaker: char-myrddin

segments.text: "Bydd y ddraig yn aros yma, gyda fi a fy ffwrn i!" meddai Modlen.
segments.speaker: char-modlen

segments.speaker: char-dafi

segments.text: "Dw i eisiau gweld Caerllion, a'r cleddyf yn y garreg, a'r wledd."
"Os wyt ti'n aros yma, byddi di'n cael pastai afal bob bore," meddai Modlen.
segments.speaker: char-modlen

segments.text: "Pastai bob bore?" meddai Dafi, ac roedd yr het yn dawel am funud.
segments.speaker: char-dafi

segments.text: "Wel… diolch, Modlen."
Gwenodd Modlen.
Ond doedd Myrddin ddim yn gwenu: roedd e'n edrych ar y sach fara.
Y noson honno, roedd pawb yn cysgu, ac roedd y gert yn y buarth, yn llawn o sachau.

inference_aids.alt: Night in the snowy llys yard: the loaded cart stands by the stable with a white sack on top, and tiny Dafi creeps from the kitchen across the yard towards it while old Pero sleeps by the stable door.
inference_aids.art_brief: Night in the llys yard (match place-buarth.png; llys palette under dark blue night light, thin snow on the ground and on the thatch). A plain wooden two-wheeled cart piled high with tied cloth sacks, one white sack on top, stands by the stable. A faint glow comes from the kitchen door; from it a tiny red dragon (Dafi: cup-sized, two short cream horns, tiny bat wings, big yellow eyes) tiptoes across the snowy yard towards the cart, leaving tiny footprints. Old Pero (large shaggy black-and-white hound, grey muzzle) lies asleep by the stable door. Everything else dark and still. No text.

segments.text: Daeth rhywbeth bach coch o'r gegin, a cherddodd e'n dawel drwy'r buarth tuag at y gert.

Wedyn aeth e i'r sach fara, a chuddiodd e yno.

Roedd Cynyr, Cai ac Elen ar eu ceffylau, ac roedd Arth, Mali a Myrddin yn y gert gyda'r sachau.
Ond doedd dim mwg yn dod o'r ffwrn, a daeth Modlen i'r buarth gyda'i llwy bren.
"Mae'r ddraig ar goll!" meddai Modlen.

segments.text: Yn y llys, roedd Modlen yn sefyll wrth ei ffwrn oer, ac roedd Pero wrth ei thraed hi.

grammar.nodyn_en: Os (if) sets a real condition. With the future: Os bydd hi'n bwrw eira, byddwn ni'n mynd yn araf. With the present: os wyt ti (not rwyt ti), os yw / ydy e (not mae e), os dw i. Weather uses hi: Mae hi'n bwrw glaw, Mae hi'n braf. Pan (when) treats the event as expected; os leaves it open.
